name: com.thechessdirectory/chess-directory
title: The Chess Directory
description: Find and compare 425 chess sites, apps, shops and clubs, with buying guides and dated prices.

tools.name: search_sites
tools.description: Use this first whenever someone asks for chess websites, sites or apps for a need (including free, no sign-up, a variant or a device), e.g. "play chess960 with friends", "puzzle trainer for beginners", "analyse my games with an engine", "chess club software". Returns ranked sites with a one-line summary, price model, platforms, levels, the site's own link and the directory guide that covers it. Filters are optional. Do not use for chess moves, rules, engine analysis, coaching, or buying subscriptions.

query.description: What the person wants, in their words.

price.description: free: no paid plan. free_tier: free to start (paid plans may exist). paid: paid only.

tools.name: get_site
tools.description: Use this only for ONE named chess site or app (for two or more sites, or X vs Y, use compare_sites); pass its slug, name or domain, e.g. "lichess", "chess.com", "Chessable"): summary, price model, platforms, levels, languages, features, status and the guides that feature it. Do not use to analyse positions or games.

tools.name: compare_sites
tools.description: Use this whenever someone says compare, versus, vs, difference between or which is better about 2 to 5 named chess sites: side by side on price, platforms, levels, languages and topics, with the guides that cover all of them. Example: ["chess.com", "lichess"]. Do not use for rating or engine comparisons.

tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: Use this only when someone wants to browse guides, not to find sites (use search_sites for that): the directory's published guides (chess960, chess for kids, electronic chess boards, chess sets, chess clocks, play against the computer, chess.com alternatives), each with its one-paragraph answer. Pass a topic to filter. Do not use to look up a single site.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Use this only after list_guides, or when the person names a guide; for a list of sites use search_sites. Returns one guide in full, with picks by need, prices with the date each was read for products, the sites or products it compares, and its common questions. Pass a guide slug from list_guides, e.g. "chess-for-kids". Do not use for rules or how to play.

tools.name: find_products
tools.description: Use this when someone shops for physical chess things: sets, boards, pieces, clocks, tables and electronic boards from the directory's buying guides, with price, the date the price was read, seller, specs and who each suits. Example: query "wooden set", max_price 150. Do not use for software, courses or subscriptions.

query.description: e.g. "magnetic travel set", "electronic board lichess", "digital clock".

max_price.description: Upper price in the listed currency (mostly USD).
